question: For each concert, how many singers performed? Include concerts with no listed performers.
reference_sql: SELECT c.concert_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) FROM concert AS c LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
candidate_sql:
SELECT
    c.concert_ID,
    c.concert_Name,
    COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count
FROM concert AS c
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
    ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name;
evaluation_evidence: Candidate results differ from the reference results.
